provenance: SYNTHETIC, AND DELIBERATELY SO -- this is HYPOTHESIS (a) about a field nobody in this repo has measured. It is batch_oom_container_reason with the container reason re-keyed from `Reason` to `reason`, the spelling the DescribeJobs API itself uses and the one the DSG-TAIL F1 probe read when it recorded 'container reason None'. Nothing else moves.
why_it_is_here: THE REGRESSION FENCE. Against the 2026-09-06 draft of the classifier this exact document classified RecordSourceFailureFetch -- an OOM-killed fetch leg TOLERATED, Bronze entered on an incomplete fetch -- while HEAD's whole-Cause substring rule returned RecordInfraFailureFetch. The signal-exit arm (137 >= 128) now carries the class off a MEASURED field, so the spelling cannot decide it either way.
